'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]]
***At least one person is killed and 12 others are injured when a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] hits a nine-storey residential building in [[Dnipro]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-strike-damages-residential-building-ukraines-dnipro-2024-06-28/ (Reuters)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]] claims that its forces have taken control of the village of [[Rozdolivka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russia-claims-it-took-control-of-ukrainian-settlement-of-rozdolivka/3260971 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[New People's Army rebellion]]
**[[Philippine Army|Philippine]] troops claim to have killed at least ten suspected [[Communism in the Philippines|communist]] [[guerrilla]]s, including three commanders, near a village in [[Pantabangan]], [[Nueva Ecija]], Philippines. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/philippine-troops-kill-10-communist-rebels-clash-latest-111505277 (ABC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Argentine Chamber of Deputies]] approves economic reform measures proposed by [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Javier Milei]], which include investment incentives, the [[privatization]] of numerous state-owned entities, and tax overhauls. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-poised-pass-economic-reform-bill-mileis-first-big-legislative-win-2024-06-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are killed and nine others are injured when a [[minivan]] [[traffic collision|crashes]] into a [[nail salon]] in [[Deer Park, New York|Deer Park]], [[Long Island]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/deer-park-long-island-crash/ (WCBS-TV)]
*A roof at the [[Indira Gandhi International Airport]] in [[New Delhi]], [[India]], collapses amid heavy rains killing one person, injuring eight others, and leading to the cancellation of some [[domestic flight]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/roof-collapses-airport-indian-capital-departures-cancelled-2024-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*A magnitude 7.2 [[list of earthquakes in Peru|earthquake]] strikes off the coast of central [[Peru]], injuring 23 people. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-06-28/magnitude-7-0-earthquake-hits-atiquipa-peru-no-tsunami-threat (Bloomberg)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Humanitarian aid during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] dismantles the [[Gaza floating pier]] for the third time due to bad weather. [https://apnews.com/article/gaza-pier-humanitarian-aid-f3e21c072630c0d9cb9498d3a0e27a55 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A [[mass shooting]] in [[Corpus Christi, Texas|Corpus Christi]], [[Texas]], United States kills two people, an 18-year-old and a 15-year-old, and leaves three other people injured including two 19-year-olds and a 20-year-old. [https://kdhnews.com/news/texas/multiple-victims-hospitalized-after-buford-street-shooting-in-corpus-christi/article_4aa7ac4b-6fd6-50ef-a04e-d5b54d7d2dc0.html (''Killeen Daily Herald'')]
*[[Law enforcement in the United Kingdom|British police]] arrest 27 [[Just Stop Oil]] activists accused of planning to disrupt airports during the upcoming summer holidays. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-police-arrest-27-activists-over-alleged-plans-disrupt-airports-2024-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Maldives|Maldivian]] Minister of the Environment [[Fathima Shamnaz Ali Saleem]] and three others are arrested for allegedly performing [[black magic]] on [[President of the Maldives|President]] [[Mohamed Muizzu]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/maldives-minister-arrested-for-performing-black-magic-on-president-muizzu-report-101719532900727.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*[[Government of Indonesia|Indonesian]] officials arrest and intend to deport 103 [[Taiwan]]ese nationals suspected of running a [[cybercrime]] operation in [[Tabanan]], [[Bali]], Indonesia. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/28/indonesia-says-will-deport-103-taiwanese-suspected-of-cybercrimes-in-bali (Al Jazeera)]
*George Alvarez, the perpetrator of the [[2023 Brownsville crash]] in [[Texas]], United States, that killed eight people and injured ten others is found guilty of eight counts of [[manslaughter#vehicular and intoxicated|intoxication manslaughter]] and ten counts of [[aggravated assault]] with a deadly weapon and is sentenced to sixty years in prison. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/driver-convicted-in-deaths-of-8-people-struck-by-suv-outside-migrant-shelter-sentenced-to-60-years-1.6945999 (CTV News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Iranian presidential election]]
**[[Iran]]ians vote in a [[Iranian presidential election|snap presidential election]] following [[2024 Varzaqan helicopter crash|the death]] of president [[Ebrahim Raisi]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-presidential-election-ebrahim-raisi-mideast-tensions-6081dc2b8a9ff4c310e148edacf51b29 (AP)]
*[[2024 Mongolian parliamentary election]]
**[[Mongolians]] vote for members of the [[State Great Khural]]. This is the first election since the Khural was expanded to 126 seats and the first to use [[parallel voting]]. The ruling [[Mongolian People's Party]] loses its supermajority but claims victory, maintaining a slim simple majority. [https://apnews.com/article/mongolia-parliament-election-democracy-bdf3852aed557d710570f1331b2998a4 (AP)]
*[[Jadar mine|Jadar mining project]]
**Thousands of [[Serbians]] protest in [[Loznica]], [[Serbia]], against the [[Rio Tinto (corporation)|Rio Tinto]] mining company and its plans to develop a [[lithium mining]] project in [[Jadar (Serbia)|Jadar]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/serbias-green-activists-rally-against-rio-tinto-lithium-project-2024-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*Thousands of [[Japanese people]] protest at the [[Embassy of the United States, Tokyo|U.S. Embassy in Tokyo]] over multiple alleged [[sexual assault]] cases involving [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. service members]] against Japanese people on [[Okinawa Island]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/28/japan-protests-alleged-sex-assault-cases-involving-us-military-in-okinawa (Al Jazeera)]
